```plato
//==
// # Measurement, calibration, and ensemble readings
//
// The derived readings of the provenance records in
// `uncertainty.types.plato`: when a reading was taken relative to
// another, whether a calibration is still the one in force, and the sampled
// statistics of an ensemble.
//
// Ensemble statistics are weighted: the mean is the weight-normalized average
// of the draws, so an unweighted ensemble (every Weight 1) reduces to the
// plain arithmetic mean. The draws themselves are `INumerical`, which supplies
// the additive and scaling surface a weighted mean needs and nothing more.

library UncertaintyMeasurement
{
    //==
    // # Measurements

    // How long after a reference instant the reading was taken. Negative when
    // the reading precedes the reference.
    AgeSince(self: Measurement<$T>, reference: Instant): Duration
        => reference.Between(self.Timestamp);
```
